# Do NOT do these in this project

- **Do not edit `/etc/resolver/` files directly.** Supbuddy owns one file per
  managed domain suffix and prunes the ones it no longer needs; manual edits are
  overwritten. (Supbuddy does not maintain an `/etc/hosts` block — it stopped
  doing so long ago and only cleans up legacy entries. A hand-added hosts line
  will silently shadow the resolver and outlive the project that needed it.)
- **Do not edit `Caddyfile` or run `caddy admin api` directly.** Caddy is
  managed by Supbuddy. Use `create_mapping` / `update_mapping` / `delete_mapping`
  MCP tools.
- **Do not edit Supbuddy-managed certificates.** Use `install_ca` /
  `uninstall_ca` MCP tools.
- **Do not bypass plan/apply for destructive MCP operations.** Surface the plan
  to the user, get confirmation, then call `apply(plan_id)`.
- **Do not write env files outside this project's root.** The MCP server
  rejects out-of-root writes anyway.
- **Do not commit `*.supbuddy-backup-*` files.** Supbuddy adds them to
  `.gitignore` automatically.
